title: Very thin and small for beach towels
text: Very thin and small for beach towels. Considering these towels were purchased for under $4 each, I suppose they are not bad. I need to pay more attention to measurements. All of the beach towels that we have had in the past seem much larger and thicker. These seem not only thin, but also closer to my idea of bath sized towels rather than beach sized. I also don't find them very absorbent; however, I haven't washed any as yet, so perhaps that improves with use. I've needed extra towels, in part, due to our new dog with a skin condition requiring multiple baths. I think these work in that regard. And they don't take up a lot of space, because, well, they are thin, so might be good for road trips. I kept trying to figure out the differences in color choices in terms of pricing, and couldn't see where there was really much difference other than the colors and designs. Seems like the towels themselves are essentially the same, so I went with the cheapest, the striped cabanas for, I think, about $22 for six on sale. Can't beat the price, but overall, not thrilled with the product.
